 Hon'Ble Vikram D. Chauhan, J. 
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the State-respondent.

2.  This application has been filed by applicant for quashing the summoning order dated 21.12.2020 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba as well as entire proceedings of Complaint Case No.3340 of 2020, Food Safety Officer, Mahoba Vs. Rajendra Yadav, under Section 26/51 and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, Police Station Mahoba, District Mahoba.

entities.text: Food Safety Officer, Mahoba Vs. Rajendra Yadav
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the impugned summoning order is non speaking order and it does not record application of mind.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that in view of the judgment in M/s JM Laboratories and others Vs. State of Andhra Pradesh and another, 2025 INSC 127, the summoning order is not sustainable under law.

entities.text: M/s JM Laboratories and others Vs. State of Andhra Pradesh and another, 2025 INSC 127
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. submits that the matter may be remanded back to the court concerned for decision afresh.
5. In view of the fact that there is no application of mind, the impugned summoning order dated 21.12.2020 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba is hereby set aside.
The present application is allowed and the matter is remanded back to the court concerned for decision afresh.
